clue.text: Slangy simpleton serves spirit in beakers

indicators.note: the spirit is placed in the beakers, so one word sits inside the other

parts.note: jugs are pouring vessels, like beakers
gin is a spirit

explanation.surface: A barman serving gin in laboratory beakers is called a fool in slang.
explanation.walkthrough: JUGGINS is old British slang for a gullible fool.
explanation.definitionFit: A juggins is dated British slang for a foolish or easily duped person.

clue.text: He's no master mariner!

parts.note: a jack is a sailor, and the saying ends 'master of none', so this man has many skills but masters none

explanation.definitionFit: A person with a wide range of skills but no deep expertise is a generalist of many crafts.

clue.text: Check supply of liquor and good bacon

parts.note: gin is a liquor
ham is cured pork, like bacon

explanation.surface: Someone inspects their stock of drink and quality bacon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Check' looks like a verb but is a checked fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: Gingham is a cotton cloth woven in a pattern of checks.

clue.text: Suitable for use during matins, maybe

explanation.surface: Something fit to use at a morning church service.
explanation.definitionFit: In service means operational; it also literally means taking place during a church service, such as morning prayer.

clue.text: It's heavenly under a tree

parts.note: sub means under
the lime is a tree

explanation.surface: It is bliss to lie beneath a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: Sublime means of such excellence as to inspire awe, like something divine.

clue.text: Former French currency is his

parts.note: the franc was France's money before the euro

explanation.surface: Someone owns an old French coin.
explanation.walkthrough: A whimsical definition: 'his' stands for a man's name, the one the wordplay spells out.
explanation.definitionFit: Francis is a common male forename, so the clue playfully calls it a name belonging to some man.

clue.text: Make private secretary fetch pincers

parts.note: to make someone do something is to force them
PS is short for private secretary

explanation.surface: A boss orders the assistant to fetch the pliers.
explanation.definitionFit: Forceps are surgical tongs used for gripping, a kind of pincers.

clue.text: Benefit afforded by a yashmak, they say

indicators.note: what people say is heard by ear, signalling a word that sounds the same

parts.note: a yashmak is a veil worn by some Muslim women

explanation.surface: An advantage comes from wearing a face covering, people claim.
explanation.definitionFit: Avail as a noun means use or advantage, as in 'to no avail'.

clue.text: Eastwood's running for us president

parts.note: Clint is the forename of the actor Clint Eastwood
on means running or operating

explanation.surface: Clint Eastwood is standing for office in America.
explanation.definitionFit: Bill Clinton was the 42nd President of the United States.

clue.text: They read notices out interminably

indicators.note: out signals the letters are put out of order and rearranged

explanation.surface: People read out announcements endlessly.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means for a very long time, as if from the beginning of time.

clue.text: Dog gets iodine in tinned food

indicators.note: the iodine goes in the tinned food, so its symbol sits inside

parts.note: cans hold tinned food
I is the chemical symbol for iodine

explanation.surface: A dog is fed tins of food dosed with iodine.
explanation.definitionFit: Canis is the Latin genus name of the dog.

clue.text: Twice exclude Scotsman for being a boor

indicators.note: the synonym for exclude is to be written two times over

parts.note: to bar is to exclude
Ian is a typical Scottish man's name in crosswords

explanation.surface: A Scot is shut out twice over for being uncouth.
explanation.definitionFit: A barbarian is an uncultured, rough person, a synonym for a lout.

clue.text: If not, nothing he writes can be amended

parts.note: O is the round figure for nothing

indicators.note: letters that can be amended may be altered and rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: Unless otherwise stated, none of his writing may be changed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nothing he writes' reads as a ban on editing, but 'nothing' is just the letter O, and 'can be amended' is the anagram signal for the next two words.
explanation.definitionFit: Otherwise is an adverb meaning in other circumstances, the same as 'or else'.

clue.text: Illuminated by man of supple grace

parts.note: lit means lighted up
he is the pronoun for a man

explanation.surface: A gracefully supple man is lit up by a spotlight.
explanation.definitionFit: Lithe describes a body that is flexible and graceful in movement.

clue.text: Cabinet expects more ira disturbance

indicators.note: a disturbance throws these letters into disorder, giving a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Politicians brace for further trouble from the Irish Republican Army.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disturbance' rearranges MORE IRA; 'Cabinet' looks political but is a piece of furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: An armoire is a tall wardrobe or cupboard, a kind of furniture cabinet.

clue.text: Stout stem

explanation.surface: A beer stein holds a dark ale.
explanation.definitionFit: Staunch means sturdy and loyal as an adjective, and as a verb means to stop a flow, as of blood.

clue.text: A spell in to modify aircraft instrument

indicators.note: the spell is placed in the word for modify, so it sits inside

parts.note: to alter is to modify
a spell is a period of time

explanation.surface: A magic charm is used to adapt an aeroplane gauge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spell' suggests magic but means a stretch of time.
explanation.definitionFit: An altimeter measures height above ground or sea level in planes.

clue.text: One couple in the van understand mouthings

indicators.note: the one and the couple go in the van, so they sit inside

parts.note: to be in the van is to be in the lead
I is the Roman numeral one
PR is the abbreviation for pair

explanation.surface: A single pair travel together in a removal van.
explanation.walkthrough: 'van' here is the vanguard, the front position, not a vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: To lip-read is to work out speech by watching the shapes of the speaker's lips.

clue.text: Writers I have found to be thoughtful

parts.note: pens are writing instruments
I've is short for I have

explanation.surface: Writers prove reflective.
explanation.definitionFit: Pensive means deep in thought, often wistfully.

clue.text: Put pressure on old cavalryman

explanation.surface: Someone harasses a veteran mounted soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: To dragoon is to coerce someone into acting; a dragoon was a mounted infantryman.

clue.text: Many a note written in attempt to find pets' home

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral 100, a large number

indicators.note: the note is written into the attempt, so it is placed inside

parts.note: a try is an attempt
te is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Many people write notes trying to locate a home for their animals.
explanation.definitionFit: A cattery is a boarding establishment where cats are kept while owners are away.

clue.text: It makes night driving safer in many ways

definitions.text: It makes night driving safer in many ways

parts.words: It makes night driving safer in many ways
parts.note: reflective studs set into the middle of roads show the lanes in headlights, and the ways here are roads

explanation.definitionFit: These are road studs with glass reflectors that mark lanes for drivers in the dark.

clue.text: Basic ingredient of perfume

explanation.surface: The key component of a scent.
explanation.definitionFit: Essence means the fundamental nature of something, and also a concentrated extract used as scent.

clue.text: Manage to get up before the big day

parts.note: to run a business is to manage it

explanation.surface: An early riser plans to wake ahead of a big event.
explanation.definitionFit: The run-up is the preparatory period leading to an important occasion.

clue.text: Urge to be part of the media

explanation.surface: An appeal to join the newspapers.
explanation.definitionFit: To press is to push someone; the press is the newspapers and journalists collectively.

clue.text: Plant gets airtime, as arranged

indicators.note: letters arranged are set out in a fresh order, signalling a rearrangement

explanation.surface: A factory gets broadcasting time, as agreed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arranged' rearranges AIRTIME AS; 'Plant' suggests a factory but is a botanical name.
explanation.definitionFit: Artemisia is a genus of aromatic herbs including wormwood and mugwort.

clue.text: Press the point during journey back from work

explanation.surface: A commuter argues a point while travelling home.
explanation.definitionFit: To drive something home is to make it clearly understood; the literal sense is a car trip to one's house.

clue.text: Fashion editor made a good match

parts.note: the ton means the height of fashion

explanation.surface: A fashion editor arranges a successful pairing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the ton' is an old word for fashionable society or style.
explanation.definitionFit: Colours that toned went well together, harmonising like a successful pairing.

clue.text: Tramples a child in the family

explanation.surface: Someone tramples on a youngster at home.
explanation.definitionFit: To step on is to tread down; a stepson is a spouse's son from an earlier relationship.

clue.text: Solemn sovereign born in Asia

indicators.note: the sovereign and born are placed in Asia, so they sit inside

parts.note: the East means Asia
R stands for Rex or Regina, a monarch
NE stands for née, born

explanation.surface: A grave monarch was born somewhere in Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: Earnest means serious and sincere in manner, close to grave.
